title: Daevanion catch-up for a late start
caption: A fresh Lv 39 Assassin sees "3 boards opened before you joined · Mark bought ▾": one tap per board ticks its guide nodes, with Undo.

title: Respec per board on a phone
caption: Respec ▾ opens one row per board with its ticked nodes, then All boards. Each needs a second click, then the toast offers Undo.

title: Stigmas catch-up
caption: "4 stigma slots opened before you joined · Mark equipped ▾" marks each slot in one tap. "How shards work" is now the round i button.

title: Stigmas Respec
caption: With every slot marked, the strip is gone and Respec sits at the right of the foot. It sets every stigma back to Lv 1 and gives the shards back.
